title: Implement two-band Hubbard model and DQMC solver
action: Implement the two-band Hubbard model Hamiltonian with tight-binding parameters for kz=0 (on-site energies, intra- and inter-sublattice hoppings) and a determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) simulation engine. The engine must be capable of computing spin susceptibility χ(q), pairing susceptibilities for multiple symmetries, AFM spin structure factor, and density-density correlations at finite temperature on lattices up to 2×12^2.

title: Compute spin susceptibility χ(q) peak at (π,π)
action: Run DQMC simulations on a 2×8² lattice at T/t=1/10 for U/t ∈ {1.0, 3.0, 5.0} and fillings ⟨n⟩ ∈ {1.0, 0.9, 0.8} with kz=0. Extract the static spin susceptibility χ(q) value at q=(π,π).
description: The computed peak susceptibility at (π,π) for each (U, n) combination.
output_schema: Array of objects, each with keys: U_t (float, Hubbard U in units of t), n (float, electron filling), chi_pi_pi (float, χ(π,π) value).

title: Compute pairing susceptibilities and effective pairing interaction
action: Run DQMC simulations on a 2×8² lattice with kz=0. For n=1.0 use U/t=1.0, 3.0, 5.0; for n=0.8 use U/t=3.0. For each U and n, scan temperatures T/t from about 0.5 down to 0.125. At each temperature, compute the pairing susceptibilities P_α for symmetries s_xy, d_xy, s_{x²+y²}, d_{x²-y²} and the effective pairing interaction P_eff = P_α − P̃_α.
description: Temperature and U dependence of pairing susceptibilities and effective interactions for the four pairing channels.
output_schema: Array of objects, each with keys: temperature (float, T/t), symmetry (string, one of 'sxy','dxy','sx2+y2','dx2-y2'), P (float), P_eff (float), n (float, filling 1.0 or 0.8), U_t (float, Hubbard U in units of t).

title: Compute AFM structure factor finite-size scaling
action: Run DQMC simulations on lattices of linear sizes L=8, 10, 12 (total sites N_s=2×L²) at U/t=3.0, filling ⟨n⟩=1.0, kz=0, at inverse temperature β=10. Compute the AFM spin structure factor S_AFM on the B sublattice.
description: Finite-size values of the AFM structure factor to test for long-range order.
output_schema: Array of objects, each with keys: L (int), beta (float), U_t (float, 3.0), n (float, 1.0), S_AFM (float).

title: Compute charge density wave correlation at q=(π,π)
action: Run DQMC simulations on a 2×12² lattice with nearest-neighbor repulsion V/t=0.9, U/t=3.0, filling ⟨n⟩=1.0, T/t=1/6, kz=0. Compute the density-density correlation C(R) and its Fourier transform C(q), and extract the value at q=(π,π).
description: Charge correlation at the CDW ordering vector for a single set of parameters.
output_schema: Object with keys: V_t (float, 0.9), U_t (float, 3.0), n (float, 1.0), L (int, 12), T_t (float, 0.1667), C_pi_pi (float).
